item.title: Jessica’s Pond to permanently close, Wyoming Game and Fish says
item.description: CASPER, Wyo. — The Wyoming Game and Fish Department recently announced that it is permanently closing Jessica’s Pond, a popular fishing spot in Casper. A release from Game and Fish says that the decision to close the area came due to the confirmation of invasive New Zealand mudsnails in October 2025. The pond will officially […]

item.title: Casper City Council approves 1st reading of rezoning, final plat for subdivision addition
item.description: CASPER, Wyo. — On Tuesday, the Casper City Council unanimously approved on first reading a zone change and final plat for the planned Valley Hills Addition No. 3 subdivision. item.title: Casper renews local businesses’ liquor licenses
item.description: CASPER, Wyo. — The Casper City Council renewed the liquor licenses of its local businesses at Tuesday’s meeting without dissent. All businesses seeking renewals were approved, though some were made with stipulations. Three businesses saw restrictions placed on their licenses: Frosty’s Lounge, which has stipulations restricting someone from having ownership interest in the business, and […]

item.title: Casper to conduct ecological assessment for next phase of North Platte River restoration
item.description: CASPER, Wyo. — The Casper City Council approved a contract for a vegetation and ecology assessment to guide the next phase of the North Platte River restoration project at its Tuesday meeting. item.title: Casper renews lease with Spuds for use of Mike Lansing Field
item.description: CASPER, Wyo. — Casper’s local baseball team will continue to call Mike Lansing Field home for the coming seasons after the Casper City Council unanimously voted to renew its lease of the field with the Casper Spuds. Councilors approved a non-exclusive five-year rental agreement for the team to use the stadium. Prior agreements between the […]

item.title: Casper contracts for 2026 sewer system repairs
item.description: CASPER, Wyo. — The City of Casper will move forward with plans for rehabilitation and repairs to its sewer system, after the City Council on Tuesday unanimously approved a roughly $1.6 million contract for the work. item.title: Casper City Council approves SLIB loan for city reservoir repairs
item.description: CASPER, Wyo. — During its Tuesday meeting, the Casper City Council authorized a $9.56 million loan to replace a critical piece of the municipal water infrastructure at the city’s reservoir.
